name: fix-reserved-names
body: Source: 'templates declare sections… `# notes` = speaker notes'; and 'implied body field'. Inconsistency: a template could declare a section named `notes` or a field named `body`/`*_format`, colliding with reserved author syntax. Resolution: `notes`, `body` and the `_format` suffix are reserved names rejected at template build time (template-build-checks). Also: section frontmatter fence was specified as 'plain ```'; interpreted as backtick fence only (tilde fence = error like any other fence). [autonomous]
